purpose: Resolve picker mutation/aliasing, overlap precedence, duplicate owner sequences, bitmap sampling and intervention axis/order before stable-ID composition

native_source.scope: Authenticated isolated AST bodies, actual Pillow/SciPy image path, native normalized profile objects and prior buffers; no YAML descriptor, seeding, geometry, cut, solver or checkpoint equivalence
native_source.support_hooks: Path existence/join, sequence classification and enum labels only; calc_gj_vects is recorded without rebuilding geometry. Core picker/intervention arithmetic is actual source.

source_semantics.default: Always ALL and insular=True; membership remains all, not an exclusive complement
source_semantics.overlap: Later insertion-order profiles overwrite enabled-ion Dm; earlier memberships persist
source_semantics.percent: int((percent/100)*N); np.random.shuffle(cell_i[:]) mutates a view, including for0percent; stored ALL cell arrays alias final order while materialized membrane/environment targets retain pick-time order
source_semantics.random_policy: Native RNG runs only in isolated capture; resolved full permutations are explicit independent inputs to production/reference. No production global RNG mutation or stream-parity claim
source_semantics.color: Exact seed-fill string equality, requires SVG seed tags
source_semantics.indices: Returns configured sequence unchanged; duplicates/order retained; native negative/bool/floating indices may wrap, disagree across domains or fail and are rejected in supported binding
source_semantics.image: Native PIL F decode, every pixel !=255 ->1, flipud, transposed bilinear spline, rectangle clamping and any nonzero selection; hull and unused cubic helper impose extra constraints; alpha conversion does not establish opacity masking
source_semantics.environment: Membrane-to-ECM occurrences retain duplicates; environment map key absent for empty or non-ECM profiles
source_semantics.insularity: Any insular region membership crossing blocks contact membranes; overlapping regions combine blockers, not last-write reconnect; neighbor counts remain original source counts
source_semantics.scheduled_targets: Concatenate requested profiles in order with duplicates; callback array length is not a safe owner-axis declaration
source_semantics.scheduled_membrane: amplitude*scalar*dynamics*pulse*DEFAULT profile Dm, assigned to Dm_scheduled; Na/K unguarded, Cl/Ca guard ion flags
source_semantics.scheduled_ecm: baseD*(1-eff)+eff*freeD and baseWeight*(1-eff)+eff at selected sites; signed factors retained; non-ECM branch lacks initialization
source_semantics.finalization: Dm_cells=base+scheduled, P_cells=base+mod; other target entries retain prior buffers
source_semantics.global_GJ: Integer percentage clamped1..100; copied membrane order shuffled but ignored; actual prefix selected
source_semantics.post_cut: Source reruns init_profiles/redo_gj/init_events; stable-ID carry is an explicit separate Cells policy, no automatic geometry/cut integration

units.pulse_modulators_amplitudes: Native numeric factors, signed finite source values retained
units.maps: Explicit stable IDs/indices, owner domains and ordered occurrences; no material transfer

reference: Independent stdlib owner lists, exact Fraction bitmap interpolation on decoded F32 pixels, 80-digit Decimal pulse/intervention arithmetic; external random permutations are supplied

supported_domain.layout: Unique stable IDs, explicit membrane owner/environment/per-cell ordering, finite centres/bounds, explicit SVG tags
supported_domain.selectors: Raw indices require matching layout identity; stable IDs may retain duplicates; percent requires full permutation; masks finite square4..1024/noncollinear
supported_domain.events: One per native kind, finite signed amplitude/samples, positive transition, explicit callback occurrence or owner axis, ECM events require ECM
supported_domain.numerics: Finite buffers/outputs, neutral event/target padding and explicit ion/cell/membrane/environment axes; downstream physical diffusion constraints caller-owned

scope_limits: No production global RNG mutation, hidden reselection or silent deduplication
No inferred geometry, physical graph changes, cut execution, solver or actual checkpoint migration
No material, energy, ATP, water or whole-tissue parity claim
Named callback evaluation/provenance and RNG/checkpoint ownership remain explicit caller inputs
